ctags_cross_check.explanation: Five macro-generated count accessors and one split-line getter are missed by GNU Emacs ctags but fully present in Clang AST; no unclassified lexical method candidates.

declaration_scope: Every explicit structure, enum/alias, macro, global store and method occurrence in the relocated pair and direct companion services; compiler-generated implicit members/instantiations and local variables are not independent APIs.
caller_index_scope: Lexical code references in osprey C/C++ sources; comments/literals excluded. Definition candidates checked by balanced argument/body syntax; same-spelled static functions in other TUs are not linkage proof. This is not an IPA/dynamic call graph.

type_dependency.owner: Foreign WN/PU/map type dependencies of nonpersistent service declarations
type_dependency.reason: Forward declarations/aliases are not persistent DSL definitions. Remove these dependencies from the persistent header and include or forward-declare them only in the actual owning service interfaces; do not relocate the underlying Open64 core types.
type_dependency.lifetime: Borrowed core compiler type identity; no new .B encoding.

logical_print.reason: Printer declaration is a service, not image data. Existing dsl_ir_print.cxx owns its implementation; inventory destination moves inspection logic together, not only the prototype.
logical_print.lifetime: Readable coherent image plus caller-owned output stream; printing creates no new image record.

persistent_schema.reason: Actual image header/row or symbolic encoding of its fields; no transient compiler request is admitted.
persistent_schema.lifetime: Binary artifact plus corresponding shared ST/TY/string/TCON tables; preserve every field/ID/version/layout.

image_store.owner: Managed fixed-row WHIRL image storage and structural record services
image_store.reason: Direct persistent-row operations and their live containers/support are not additional .B records. Proposed specific image-store owner outside common/com, not a generic transient bucket.
image_store.lifetime: Image lifetime; IDs/borrowed rows expire on reset/replacement, and append rollback is not arbitrary old-row recovery.

image_layout_checks.reason: Typedef-char assertions are compile-time checks, not persisted structures; retain/rebuild their exact ABI assertions outside the schema directory.
image_layout_checks.lifetime: Compile time only; no runtime state or .B bytes.

image_io.reason: Borrowed section views and their methods are process-local even when the pointed-to row bytes are persistent. Keep parse/commit logic with the views outside common/com.
image_io.lifetime: Mapped buffer readable/aligned through validation/commit; live store copied/updated only at existing commit boundary; no pointers persisted.

call_association.owner: Live WN-call to persisted-callsite binding and offset finalization
call_association.reason: Live WN pointers and active map associations are not .B rows. Mixed row/association APIs must separate association ownership from pure row checks/access before migration.
call_association.lifetime: Borrow owning PU tree/map; rebind after mapped reopen, invalidate before tree/map release; no PU activation authority.

physical_interface.owner: Backend-free active-PU physical CALL/FUNC_ENTRY ABI verification
physical_interface.reason: Reads physical WNs/local ST tables and sorts formals; readers/builders also call this logic. Proposed specific WHIRL-PU verifier owner outside common/com must remain independent of backend code generation.
physical_interface.lifetime: Matching driver-established active PU, symtab, tree and map; never switch to other PUs.

runtime_projection.reason: Requests/plans/results drive physical handle/formal/call/return rewrites; persisted projection records remain schema, not these transient aggregates.
runtime_projection.lifetime: Caller-owned request arrays; one active-PU application; lifetime and output/failure behavior must survive relocation.

program_projection.owner: Program-plan admission and active-PU interface evolution mechanism
program_projection.reason: Retirement/resource plans, results and commit fingerprints are transient. Cross-PU planning policy is an IPA scope gate, not authority supplied by this mechanism.
program_projection.lifetime: Prepared plan and image/PU commit interval, matching active PU for local interpretation; preserve reset/commit fingerprint semantics.

external_materialize.reason: Preflight/create/rewrite requests and result aggregates are not rows. Materialization mutates ST/WN/image together and reuses backend-free tensor fact access; domain-neutral construction is not inherently FHE.
external_materialize.lifetime: Active source/target PU and borrowed shared strings; side payload facts persist through TCON/ST metadata, not the C++ view/request.

typed_external.owner: Typed external-tensor source capture, generation-qualified proof and materialization
typed_external.reason: Generation/index handle and copied source snapshot are transient; individual lineage facts persist in existing node attributes and associated metadata, not a lineage DTO. Source and target activation remains caller-owned.
typed_external.lifetime: Snapshot survives caller-controlled PU switches but expires on image/source reset; no source pointer is persisted and no IPA scope is granted.

generated_external.reason: Generation request/result is transient even though flags, generation strings and ordinals are preserved in existing node attributes and associated metadata.
generated_external.lifetime: One active-PU transaction; returned metadata strings borrowed until mutation/reset; preserve all-or-nothing reported rejection behavior.

native_rewrite.owner: Generic active-PU native/logical rewrite and redirect/retire transaction
native_rewrite.reason: Request arrays, WN templates and use scans are transient transaction logic. Move helpers with the requests; pure row mutation is a separate image-store operation.
native_rewrite.lifetime: One authorized active PU; borrowed definitions/templates, preflight then commit, owner-safe dominance/use and REGION/call checks.

shared_tensor_verify.owner: Backend-free external-tensor/lineage/provenance fact access and active-PU verification
shared_tensor_verify.reason: Readers and native builders call typed/generated validation, which needs borrowed tensor/lineage/provenance views and parsing helpers. Move this actual verifier logic and its DTOs together outside common/com without adding a frontend-to-backend dependency.
shared_tensor_verify.lifetime: Caller-established active PU when required; returned strings borrow image/ST/TY/TCON metadata. Persisted facts remain in existing node attributes/tables, not these DTOs.

native_lower.reason: Lowering modes, relation/result aggregates and detached-block requests are not image rows; result lookup derives a transient summary from persistent relations.
native_lower.lifetime: Active PU and detached-block ownership; source rows retained as lowered/dead provenance; no executable work from transient proof alone.

type_refine.owner: Active-PU atomic tensor type refinement transaction
type_refine.reason: Type-refinement request/result counts are transient; selected ST/TY/value updates become persistent only through existing tables.
type_refine.lifetime: One active PU; expected-old-type preflight, array-level commit/rollback without adding an image schema.

ckks_expand.reason: CKKS step/call/use/operand scans, expansion policy, savepoint and fault injection belong with the scheme-specific executable expansion, not generic persistent IR.
ckks_expand.lifetime: Owner-PU expansion interval; event and source rows may persist, but journal/physical WNs/fault stage do not. Preserve partial rollback limitations.

pu_clone.owner: Generic physical/logical PU clone transaction mechanism
pu_clone.reason: Clone value-pair maps and count-only journals are transient; keep data with clone/save/restore logic. Current cross-PU driver use requires separate IPA ownership review before any move.
pu_clone.lifetime: Source and clone contexts supplied by the owning transaction; intact same-image prefixes; append-only restore does not restore strings/ST/WN/domain stores.

mixed_reset.owner: Split persistent table lifetime from phase-owned transient invalidation
mixed_reset.reason: Current reset clears persisted tables plus external-source handles or prepared-plan/commit state. Driver/owner must coordinate callbacks explicitly; image support must not acquire backend references.
mixed_reset.lifetime: Whole-image lifetime boundary, not PU rollback; transient invalidation must still precede any ID reuse.

mixed_runtime_input.owner: Split persistent runtime-input validation from active-source tensor proof
mixed_runtime_input.reason: Current row predicate conditionally invokes a borrowed external-tensor view when the source PU is active. Reader-only row legality must not depend on backend transient types.
mixed_runtime_input.lifetime: Shared image validation independent of PU plus separately supplied active-PU proof; preserve current context-sensitive acceptance until explicitly reviewed.

mixed_lower_relation.owner: Split persistent lowered-relation validation from transient result adapters and CKKS-specific joins
mixed_lower_relation.reason: Persistent cross-table integrity checks currently consume a transient lower-result and CKKS event knowledge. Keep pure row joins reader-linkable, transient result construction backend-owned, scheme-specific persisted joins FHE-owned.
mixed_lower_relation.lifetime: Live/proposed coherent image families, prevalidated core link ranges; result object is derived and never a .B row.

mixed_node_rewrite.owner: Split transient logical rewrite request from persistent row/link mutation
mixed_node_rewrite.reason: Current node rewrite API accepts borrowed arrays in a nonpersistent request; row-range rebuilding and persistent identity changes must remain a narrow store primitive, not expose phase request types.
mixed_node_rewrite.lifetime: Request borrowed during commit; no physical-WN atomicity from this row helper alone.

mixed_mapped_commit.owner: Split paired mapped-image commit from transient program-plan commit marking
mixed_mapped_commit.reason: Mapped load/commit invokes a nonpersistent program commit-state marker. Preserve existing admission/reset behavior without linking mapped readers to backend plan logic.
mixed_mapped_commit.lifetime: Both borrowed sections valid through parse/cross-check/commit; commit-marker state is process-only.

external_region.owner: Existing REGION symbol-use/redirect mechanism used by owner-PU transactions
external_region.reason: Local extern declarations refer to out-of-scope REGION implementations; callers manipulate live PU trees and REGION state. Record the dependency; audit companion implementation before relocation.
external_region.lifetime: Owner PU and live REGION store; no automatic widening to IPA.
